prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game/WebAR texture asset, NOT a mockup. Create ONLY a single flat circular stage floor disc seen EXACTLY FROM ABOVE, orthographic top-down camera, a perfect circle. Centered on square 1024x1024 transparent canvas, disk diameter 860px with clear padding on all sides. Warm medium brown bamboo/wood texture with restrained fine grain, narrow outer border in black and cream geometric woven zigzag inspired by the supplied Phi Ta Khon character costume. Reference image is palette/style only. Hand painted illustration matching the reference's black, brown, cream and ochre aesthetic. Simple quiet center so character remains prominent. This will be mapped onto a horizontal plane and become an ellipse naturally through AR perspective; DO NOT bake perspective into the image. No raised rim, no vertical sides, no cast shadow, no character, no postcard, no UI, no text. Everything outside the circle must be true alpha transparency, no checkerboard painted into pixels. Clean production-ready single isolated asset.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production WebAR transparent shadow texture ONLY: a single centered soft neutral black elliptical contact shadow, horizontally oriented, width 75% of square 1024x1024 canvas and height 30%. Darkness at center about 35 percent opacity, fading smoothly to fully transparent without a hard outline. Orthographic flat 2D alpha mask appearance for a stylized standing character's grounding shadow. No object, no feet, no floor, no white background, no glow, no text, no checkerboard drawn into the pixels. Truly transparent background and soft partially transparent shadow edges. This isolated texture will be placed horizontally on a miniature AR stage under a PNG character.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE isolated production 2.5D WebAR BACKDROP PNG with true transparent background. Landscape canvas 1536x1024. The reference image is existing printed postcard artwork and provides the visual language only: hand painted papery textures, cream cloud curls, ochre distant mountain silhouettes, charcoal outlines, warm brown, black and ivory. Draw a modest low panoramic paper theatre cutout of two or three distant mountain silhouettes framing a small sun and a few cloud curls, visually restrained and symmetrical enough for a miniature postcard stage. Artwork occupies bottom 60 percent with a straight shared baseline at 85 percent canvas height and clear transparent padding below and all sides. Top silhouette follows mountains/clouds with actual transparent sky above and through gaps. Keep middle of composition lower and subdued so the upright character in front stays prominent. Flat front elevation orthographic 2D illustration, NOT perspective. This is a single upright rear layer, not a complete scene. No floor, no stage base, no character, no mask, no buildings, no text, no lettering, no frame, no mockup, no shadow, no checkerboard baked into image.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2.5D WebAR foreground layer asset ONLY, true transparent background, landscape canvas 1536x1024. Reference postcard supplies exact hand painted papery black/ivory/ochre/brown style. Create a very low strip of torn cloth pennant fragments at the left and right lower corners joined by a thin dark brown curved fabric hem along bottom. Two small ochre brass bells attached near far left and right, matching postcard costume bells. Center 60 percent must remain almost completely transparent/open above this thin hem so character legs are not obscured. All artwork restricted to lowest quarter of canvas, no elements touching canvas edge, clear margin on every side, shared baseline at 85 percent canvas height. Flat front orthographic view, crisp black ink outlines and restrained fabric texture. Use opacity only on actual cloth and bells; outside these shapes is fully transparent, NO brown haze, NO glow, NO backdrop, NO paper rectangle, NO dark vignette, NO ground, NO shadow, NO scenery, NO character, NO text. This is a separate miniature paper-theatre front cutout layer to sit near the front of a postcard stage, not an entire illustration.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied existing Phi Ta Khon character into ONE full-body waving pose PNG for WebAR. Keep exactly the same character identity, distinctive very tall basket-weave ochre horned mask, black flame motif on forehead, red eyes, long wooden nose and white grinning mouth, black neck drapes and black/cream/brown torn-cloth costume, ankle bells and black sneakers, hand-inked illustrated style. Change only the raised screen-left arm into a friendly open-palm greeting near shoulder level and subtly relax screen-right arm; preserve the mask/head, torso and especially the feet positions and overall scale as close to reference as possible. Portrait canvas 1024x1536; both horn tips and both sneakers fully in frame with clear transparent padding, character centered, soles around y=1440, midpoint between feet x=512. ONE single pose, no sprite sheet. Remove the reference image's entire dark backdrop AND every brown glow/halo. True alpha transparency in all gaps including between legs, arm and body, and around fingers. No stage, shadow, paper rectangle, scenery, text or UI. Clean cutout silhouette with no painted background; retain the black clothing and outlines without erasing them.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit reference existing Phi Ta Khon illustrated character into a single storytelling/gesturing pose for an upright PNG WebAR sprite. Keep its distinctive tall ochre basket-woven horned mask, black flame crest, red eyes, white mouth, long wooden nose, black/ivory/brown rag costume, cloth pattern, black gloves, ankle bells and black sneakers with same hand inked illustration texture. Preserve head orientation and torso and feet locations as closely as possible to reference. Change screen-left arm to a lower palm-up explanatory gesture around chest/waist level, screen-right arm gently open at side, conveying a welcoming narrator. The mask is rigid: do not animate mouth or alter face. Portrait 1024x1536 canvas, full horns and both shoes visible with clear padding, same overall character scale as reference, center between feet near x512, soles near y1440. Exactly one pose, not sprite sheet, no multiple characters. Remove all background and aura from reference to true alpha transparency including between horns, fingers, legs and arm gaps. No stage, no shadow, no backdrop, no UI, no text, no paper rectangle. Preserve black clothing and crisp silhouette. This will alternate with idle and wave after per-pose alignment in code.
